Execute Over-Representation Analysis (ORA) for Up/Down Peaks

Source: R/utils_bulk.R
bulkUtils_execute_ora.Rd

Runs ORA for up- and down-regulated peaks, using KEGG pathway definitions and organism-specific filtering.

Usage

bulkUtils_execute_ora(
  de_peaks,
  path_dict,
  background,
  min_path_size,
  ora_pvalue_cutoff,
  min_pathway_hits,
  peak_direction,
  organism,
  anno,
  kegg_db
)

Arguments

de_peaks

Data frame of differential peaks, must include columns 'lfc' and 'kegg_id'.

path_dict

Not used (legacy argument, ignored).

background

Not used (legacy argument, ignored).

min_path_size

Minimum pathway size to include in ORA.

ora_pvalue_cutoff

Not used (legacy argument, ignored).

min_pathway_hits

Minimum number of hits in a pathway to include in results.

peak_direction

Not used (legacy argument, ignored).

organism

Character string: 'Human', 'Mouse', or 'Rat'. Used to filter KEGG pathways.

anno

Data frame with annotation, must include 'kegg_id'.

kegg_db

Data frame with KEGG pathway definitions, must include columns 'pathway_name', 'compound_id', and organism-specific columns.

Value

Data frame of ORA results for up- and down-regulated peaks, or NULL if no peaks are present.

Details

Used internally by the ORA Shiny panel. Pathways with <2 or >500 entries are excluded. Only pathways for the specified organism are used.
